mentions.name: Chartrow
mentions.description: This web app provides fast, dense stock market data visualizations, including drawdown (from 52-week high) charts for top YTD performers in the NASDAQ 100, dense chart views of ETF holdings such as ARKK, business fundamental trend charts (e.g., Microsoft), and multiple views of top-performing stocks as charts, heatmap, and calendar, with switchable chart/table/heatmap views and a responsive, snappy feel.
